design_philosophy: A premium, vibrant, fast-paced casual mobile card game. Uses deep night-sky purples anchored by electric teal highlights. The UI feels tactile, rounded, and magical, drawing inspiration from high-end battlers like Clash Royale and Marvel Snap. Legibility, thumb-reach, and rapid interaction are prioritized.

action_cards.visual: Circle with a slash, vibrant glow

Splash.layout: Full screen background (arena_bg). Central animated game logo. Progress bar at bottom.

LoginGuest.layout: Centered branding. Large 'Play as Guest' button (primary). 'Sign in with Google' button (secondary) below it.
LoginGuest.visuals: Uses arena_bg with heavy dark vignette.

HomeLobby.layout: Top bar: User avatar (top left), Level/XP bar, Coins and Tickets (top right). Center: 3D character or featured card. Bottom-center: Massive 'PLAY' button. Bottom: Tab navigation (Home, Play, Missions, Leaderboard, Profile).
HomeLobby.visuals: Bento-style UI panels for daily streak and quick missions.

Matchmaking.layout: Mode selection (Casual, Ranked, Private). Searching animation (radar or swirling magical energy). Estimated time indicator.

GameTable.layout: Portrait mobile-first layout. Top: Opponent 1 (Avatar, Card Count). Left/Right: Opponents 2 & 3. Center: Discard pile (top card visible), Draw pile. Current color indicator ring. Bottom: Player's hand of cards (fanned out or scrollable), overlapping. 'UNO/Rush' button floating on right.
GameTable.visuals: Table background is a stylized magical arena floor. Turn indicator is a glowing ring around the active player's avatar.

Results.layout: Victory/Defeat text (massive, glowing). Rewards chest opening animation. XP gained, Coins earned. 'Watch Ad to Double' button.
Results.visuals: Confetti or rain particles. High contrast.

DailyRewards.layout: 7-day track. Days 1-6 are small glowing orbs/coins, Day 7 is a massive reward_chest.

Missions.layout: List of tasks (e.g., 'Play 5 Flame Cards'). Progress bars for each. Claim button when complete.
Missions.visuals: Cards with glowing borders when claimable.

Leaderboard.layout: Top 3 players on podiums. List of players below. Current user highlighted in the list. League badge (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Master) displayed.

Profile.layout: Large Avatar. Username. Stats grid (Matches Played, Win Rate, Total Trophies). Match history list.

Shop.layout: Grid of cosmetic items (Card Backs, Avatars, Table Themes). Virtual currency prices.
Shop.visuals: Premium showroom lighting, soft spotlights on items.

Settings_Privacy_Terms_Admin.layout: Standard list views with toggles for sound/haptics. Admin panel for debug features.

animations_and_motion.card_draw: Slide up from deck to hand with a slight rotation and scale pop (spring physics).
animations_and_motion.card_play: Arc trajectory from hand to discard pile, screen shakes slightly on heavy action cards.
animations_and_motion.turn_change: Glowing aura immediately snaps to the active player's avatar with a soft pulse.
animations_and_motion.chest_open: Wobble, burst of light (scale 0 to 1 with overshoot), particles fly out to coin meters.

arena_bg.description: Magical arena background for Splash and Home screens.

card_back.description: Premium geometric card back for the draw pile and opponent hands.

reward_chest.description: Glowing reward chest for daily streak and match victories.

player_avatar.description: Default premium avatar for the player/guest.

testing_guidelines.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo project. Translate the Tailwind-like class strings in this JSON into React Native StyleSheet objects or use NativeWind if configured.
Do NOT use pure HTML/CSS web elements (like <div>). Map everything to <View>, <Text>, <Image>, <TouchableOpacity>, etc. Ensure to write code for React Native Expo strictly.
Prioritize smooth animations using React Native Reanimated or the Animated API. Card dealing and playing must feel responsive and snappy.
Use the provided image URLs via the <Image source={{ uri: '...' }} /> component.
Implement the 'data-testid' rule rigorously using the 'testID' prop in React Native for all interactive elements.
Ensure the Game Table screen logic effectively manages state for 4 players, placing the user at the bottom.
Remember to mock the Ad service for the 'Double Rewards' feature.
Apply safe area insets (e.g., react-native-safe-area-context) heavily, especially for the bottom tab bar and top header.
